source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

original_test_intent: Verify that an approved bounded set of AMD PBS values persists across save/reboot and returns to platform-revision-specific SPEC defaults after Load Default without unexpected device, power, security, boot or OS regressions.
original_method: Change selected AMD PBS fields in BIOS, save/reboot and verify persistence; then Load Default, save/reboot and compare with SPEC while collecting platform, device, boot, power/thermal and log evidence.
manual_activity: A human must navigate the vendor-specific AMD PBS page, perform approved changes and both save/reboot/default phases, and inspect values. Automated platform telemetry is supporting evidence only.
required_inputs: Named PBS fields with baseline, safe non-default and SPEC-default values
Per-field affected devices, power/thermal, security, boot and firmware-update behavior
Console/operator, stable power, backups and BMC/OOB/vendor recovery
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or apply values from another AMD board/firmware revision.
Treat undocumented PBS controls as non-executable until vendor semantics are supplied.
Do not change security, power-limit, device-routing or firmware-update controls without separate impact and recovery review.
Stop on device loss, power/thermal alarm, security change, hang, boot or management loss.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only platform identity, CPU/memory/PCI/device, power/thermal, boot, OS and BMC health evidence.
Compare firmware captures and platform state against the approved per-field matrix.
Do not drive BIOS, infer proprietary PBS semantics, choose values or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Obtain/approve revision-correct PBS field/default/impact definitions and recovery.
Evaluate firmware and platform evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent execution of the BIOS page. No source command exists; generic telemetry cannot establish the meaning or correctness of vendor-private PBS fields.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain manual PBS operation and add only approved read-only evidence tied to each documented field; do not substitute OS tuning, device-routing or register-write tools.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source AMD two-phase sequence, no-script state and 5/20-minute fields are preserved; all/random is preserved as source but rejected as a safe execution selector.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For every approved PBS control, bind exact firmware revision, baseline, non-default, SPEC default, affected subsystem and abort/recovery condition; capture firmware and corresponding read-only platform state through all phases.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact AMD board and vendor BIOS implementation, not AMD systems generally.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record CPU family/stepping, board revision, BIOS/vendor firmware, BMC, OS and evidence-tool versions without inventing unavailable identifiers.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor PBS specification and project platform/recipe definition for the exact revision.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds revision and subsystem causality and removes arbitrary selection at execution while retaining persistence/default coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction for the approved matrix; undocumented or excluded fields are explicitly not claimed.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Vendor field/default/effect definitions and recovery limits.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: PBS is vendor/platform specific; public generic AMD documentation cannot validate private field semantics.

project_override_considerations: The project selects supported PBS fields and observation scope. Results apply only to the exact revision and matrix and must not claim all PBS controls or other boards.
expected_evidence: Exact platform identity, approval, subsystem baseline and recovery readiness
First save/reboot persistence plus affected-subsystem evidence
Load Default, second save/reboot, SPEC comparison and platform health
Final profile, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria coherently require persistence and default restoration. Missing proprietary field semantics are readiness inputs, not opposing source facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The lifecycle is clear. Undocumented fields remain non-executable, but vendor/project inputs can define a safe matrix without making the library case permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with manual classification and adds proprietary-field/revision safety.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains platform evidence and recovery controls but rejects PARTIAL based solely on supporting automation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Restores MANUAL ONLY and constrains claims to documented fields on one platform revision.

review_improvement: Prevents vendor-private PBS controls from being guessed or copied across platforms and ties each change to an observable subsystem and recovery boundary.
independent_technical_reasoning: Human firmware actions and visual state comparison remain core, so MANUAL ONLY applies. Telemetry cannot automate or define proprietary PBS behavior.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat a PBS change, reboot or default load after any device/power/security/boot anomaly; preserve first-failure evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
